[color=#D4D4D8]Description
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]Stardew Valley: Noite[/b]
[i]Quando a vila dorme, coisas acontecem![/i]

During the day, Stardew Valley is still Stardew Valley.

After sunset, the valley gets a second layer of play: exploration, mysteries, risk, creatures, and the kind of night that makes you stop at 10:30 PM and ask whether you should go home… or keep walking.

This is not a survival-horror overlay. The night is an opportunity. Some nights are quiet. Some nights a door is ajar, a lantern is still on at the Saloon, or something is watching from the trees.

[b]Português[/b]
De dia, o jogo continua o mesmo. Depois que o sol se põe, o vale ganha uma segunda camada: exploração, mistério, risco e descoberta — sem virar horror. A noite é uma oportunidade, não uma punição.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Installation instructions
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

1. Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] (4.1.0 or newer).
2. Download this mod and unzip it.
3. Drop the [b]StardewNight[/b] folder into your game’s [b]Mods[/b] folder.
Steam example: [font=Courier New]Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\StardewNight[/font]
4. Launch the game through SMAPI (not the vanilla exe).
5. Load a save. In the SMAPI log you should see: [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley: Noite 1.1 loaded[/font]

Optional: install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] if you want in-game sliders for intensity, the journal key, and each event type.

To uninstall, delete the [b]StardewNight[/b] folder from Mods. Your save stays compatible; night journal / reputation data simply stops being used.

[b]Português[/b]
Instale o SMAPI 4.1+, extraia a pasta [b]StardewNight[/b] em [b]Mods[/b], e abra o jogo pelo SMAPI. GMCM é opcional, só para configurar pelo menu.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Main features
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/color]


[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Night Director[/b] — from 8:00 PM the night begins; from 10:00 PM the director may roll an event based on time, weather, season, luck, moon, and how intense you set the night. Not a raw dice roll.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Events with a choice[/b] — help a wounded fox, owl, or boar (sometimes it comes home as a farm pet); escort a lost villager; open an abandoned chest; follow lights, sounds, or tracks; face a pack or a rare creature; knock on a house that was broken into; catch a thief (and maybe find their stash the next night).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Mysteries that last more than one night[/b] — the pale figure, the Hunt, thieves, a missing neighbor. Clues go in the journal. Rumors show up the next day.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Special nights[/b] — blood moon, fog, the night of the dead, migration, fire, starfall, the silent night. The HUD tells you what the sky is doing.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Night journal (J)[/b] — three pages: log, collection, open mysteries. Tab / arrows switch pages. If you want the vanilla quest log back on J, rebind the journal key in GMCM (or set [font=Courier New]"JournalKey": "N"[/font] in config.json).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Reputation[/b] — how you spend the night slowly marks you as Guardian, Hunter, Investigator, Opportunist, or Occultist.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]The village still lives when you look away[/b] — an ajar door, a villager who isn’t home until morning, Gus leaving a light on at the Saloon after 1:00 AM: [i]“You heard it too?”[/i][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Intensity 0–100[/b] — 0 is almost vanilla. 50 is the intended night. 100 is adventure mode. Each event can be turned off.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Multiplayer[/b] — host-authoritative. Everyone sees the same night; the host is the one who interacts.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[b]Português[/b]
Diretor de eventos a partir das 22:00. Animal ferido (e pets), pessoa perdida, baú, luzes, sons, rastros, matilha, criatura rara, ladrões com esconderijo, casas invadidas, figura pálida, A Caçada, abrigo de inverno, chuva de estrelas. Lua e noites especiais. Diário em J (registro / coleção / mistérios). Reputação. Luz no Saloon de madrugada. Intensidade 0–100. Multiplayer no host.

[color=#D4D4D8]================================================================================
HOW THE NIGHT WORKS 
================================================================================

[size=5][b]How the night works[/b][/size]
[i]Quando a vila dorme, coisas acontecem![/i]

The day is vanilla. This mod only wakes up after sunset. You will not get a quest marker on the map. You get a bar at the top of the screen, and a journal.

[size=4][b]The clock[/b][/size]
[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]8:00 PM[/b] — the night bar appears (moon, and sometimes a special sky). That line is the [b]kind of night[/b]. It is not a place to walk to.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]10:00 PM[/b] — the Night Director may roll [b]one[/b] event. If it does, a [b]second line[/b] appears: map name + tile numbers. That is where you go. Press the action button on the glow.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Midnight[/b] — if nothing rolled at 10:00, a rare event can still appear.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]1:00 AM[/b] — if the night was not completely quiet, the Saloon may leave a lamp on. That is a knock in Town, not a second quest.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]2:00 AM[/b] — deep night. The valley just feels later.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Some nights the sky is special and [b]nothing[/b] gets a tile. That is intended. Go home. You did not fail.

[size=4][b]The bar (HUD)[/b][/size]
[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Top line[/b] (blue) — moon / “migration night” / fog / blood moon… = mood. Changes odds. Not a destination.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Second line[/b] (gold) — [i]forest · 42, 17 · press action[/i] = there is something on that tile. Walk there.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]In Town after 1:00, a warm line for the Saloon means knock on the door, not explore the railroad again.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]If you are on the wrong map, the gold line still tells you the name (forest, railroad, beach, farm, village…).

[size=4][b]The journal (J)[/b][/size]
Vanilla’s quest log also uses J. This mod takes that key for the [b]night journal[/b] (rebind in Generic Mod Config Menu if you want quests back on J).

Tab or arrow keys: three pages.
[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Log[/b] — nights you actually touched (helped, opened, followed, fought…).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Collection[/b] — fox, owl, boar, thief, pale figure, the Hunt… [i]?[/i] means you have not met it yet. That is not a miss; it has not happened to you.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Mysteries[/b] — stories that last more than one night (figure, Hunt, thieves, a house that was empty).[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]If it is not in the journal, you did not “lose” an ending. Either you walked past the glow, or that event never rolled.

[size=4][b]Special skies (not map pins)[/b][/size]
Rolled at 8:00 PM. They only tilt what is more likely after 10:00.
[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Blood moon[/b] — creatures and the Hunt.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Fog[/b] — easier to get lost; invaded houses and lost people.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Night of the dead[/b] — mysteries and the Hunt.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Migration night[/b] — tracks, wounded animals, packs, winter shelter.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Fire night[/b] — chests, packs, thieves, broken-in houses.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Star shower[/b] — a piece of sky may fall.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Silent night[/b] — the woods go quiet; mysteries prefer the hush.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=4][b]What can happen after 10:00[/b][/size]
Not a checklist. One night, one event (usually). Walk to the gold line and choose.
[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8]Wounded fox / owl / boar — help, try to take it home as a farm pet (own walk cycle), or leave it.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Lost villager — escort, talk, or walk away (walking away costs friendship).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Abandoned chest, strange lights, strange sounds, tracks.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]A pack or a rare shadow-creature.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Thieves (clang on the farm/town) — and maybe a stash the [b]next[/b] night.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]A house with the door ajar.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]The pale figure (a letter can follow days later).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]The Hunt (prints → carcass → roar → sight → fight, over several nights).[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Winter shelter, starfall.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]The next morning, someone in the village may mention last night.

[size=4][b]Intensity[/b][/size]
0 ≈ almost no night. 50 = the intended game. 100 = adventure. Slider in Generic Mod Config Menu (Stardew Valley: Noite), or [font=Courier New]Mods/StardewNight/config.json[/font] → [font=Courier New]NightIntensity[/font].

[size=4][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size]
Everyone sees the same night. Only the [b]host[/b] presses action on the event.

[size=4][b]You did not miss the rest of the mod[/b][/size]
You are not supposed to see the Hunt, the figure, the thief stash, and a pet in one week. The director picks. The journal is the only “what have I seen?” screen. Stay out when you want to. Go to bed when you do not.

[/color]
[line]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=5][b]Como a noite funciona[/b][/size]

O dia é o Stardew de sempre. O mod só acende depois do pôr do sol. Não tem marcador no mapa. Tem uma barra no topo e um diário.

[size=4][b]O relógio[/b][/size]
[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]20:00[/b] — aparece a barra (lua, e às vezes um céu especial). Essa linha é o [b]tipo de noite[/b]. Não é um lugar.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]22:00[/b] — o diretor pode rolar [b]um[/b] evento. Se rolar, vem uma [b]segunda linha[/b]: mapa + número do tile. É para lá que você vai. Aperte ação no brilho.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]00:00[/b] — se as 22:00 foram quietas, ainda pode aparecer algo raro.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]01:00[/b] — se a noite não foi vazia, o Saloon pode deixar a luz acesa. É bater na porta na vila, não é uma segunda missão.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]02:00[/b] — noite profunda.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Tem noite especial [b]sem tile nenhum[/b]. É de propósito. Voltar para casa não é falha.

[size=4][b]A barra[/b][/size]
[/color]
[list]

[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Linha de cima[/b] (azul) — lua / noite de migração / névoa… = clima. Muda as chances. Não é destino.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Segunda linha[/b] (dourada) — [i]na ferrovia · 42, 17 · aperte ação[/i] = tem coisa naquele tile.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Na vila depois da 01:00, a linha quente do Saloon é a porta do Gus.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[size=4][b]O diário (J)[/b][/size]
O J do jogo vanilla é o diário de missões. Este mod usa o J para o [b]diário da noite[/b] (muda a tecla no Generic Mod Config Menu se quiser o vanilla de volta).

Tab ou setas: três páginas — registro do que você tocou, coleção (o [i]?[/i] é o que ainda não encontrou, não o que “perdeu”), mistérios de várias noites.

Se não está no diário, ou você passou reto do brilho, ou aquele evento não rolou.

[size=4][b]Céus especiais[/b][/size]
Às 20:00. Só empurram o que é mais provável depois das 22:00.
Lua de sangue = criaturas. Névoa = perder-se / casas / pessoa perdida. Mortos = mistério. Migração = rastros, feridos, matilha. Fogo = baú, ladrão, casa arrombada. Estrelas = estrela caída. Silenciosa = a floresta cala.

[size=4][b]Intensidade[/b][/size]
0 ≈ quase vanilla. 50 = o jogo pensado. 100 = aventura. Menu do GMCM ou [font=Courier New]NightIntensity[/font] no config.json.

[size=4][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size]
A mesma noite para todos. Só o [b]host[/b] interage.

Você não precisa ver a Caçada, a figura, o ladrão e um pet na mesma semana. O diretor escolhe. O J é a tela de “o que eu já vi”. Fica fora quando quiser. Dorme quando não quiser.[/color]
